stops.title: Kwan no
stops.caption: Adesua ɛnan, na adwumakuo.
stops.speech: Gyidifoɔ Foforɔ ne asuafoyɛ kwan no. Adesua ɛnan, na adwumakuo bi mu kɔ, a obiara wɔ board no so.

stops.title: Adesua
stops.caption: Wɔahyehyɛ, wɔakyerɛkyerɛ, wɔakyerɛw.
stops.speech: Wɔhyehyɛ adesua ma asɔre baa biara a ɔkyerɛkyerɛni ne ɛda ka ho. Kyerɛw mmaeɛ wɔ adesua no mu, na yi nnipa kɔ gyinaberɛ a ɛdi hɔ.
